snippet.title: Suika Animal Kingdom - PlayStation 4 Gameplay
snippet.description:
Welcome to Suika Animal Kingdom!
In this delightful game, explore enchanting themes like Forest, Beach, and Glacier, where your goal is to merge adorable small animals to reach larger species.
In classic Suika style, make strategic moves to create the biggest animals and score high!
With vibrant graphics and unique details for each theme, Suika Animal Kingdom invites you on a captivating journey through the wonders of nature.
Start exploring now!

Developed by Erik Games
